nodes.label: Retained native WPF islands
nodes.summary: Core carries an opaque platform description. WPF Interop owns native factories, declared-type identity, updates, detachment and one-time release; apps own native contents and durable state.

nodes.label: Text editors, passwords and selectors
nodes.summary: Core describes bound multiline text, masked passwords and indexed pickers. WPF owns native editing, read-only selection, bounded undo, theme integration and feedback suppression.

nodes.label: Responsive layout and scoped styling
nodes.summary: Core defines weighted rows/columns, fixed edge docking, bound split-pane layout, adaptive grids, alignment and theme tokens. WPF owns measurement, native splitter input, templates and interaction states. Applications own native content, durable pane sizing and data templates.

nodes.label: Launchpad product showcase
nodes.summary: Session-only Overview, Board and Details screens with Back, retained local preferences, edits and workflow actions. Sample models own routes; WPF owns native screen lifetime.

nodes.label: C# composition API
nodes.summary: Text, Button, TextField, TextEditor, PasswordField, Picker, Toggle, Scroll, stacks, modifiers, and Component<T> factories.

nodes.label: View description
nodes.summary: Records describe a view tree without owning native controls.

nodes.label: Reusable component
nodes.summary: Retained instance with Body, local state, props, and lifetime hooks.

nodes.label: Observable state
nodes.summary: Tracks value reads and notifies on unequal assignments. Notifications verify thread ownership and finish delivering to all observers before propagating errors.

nodes.label: Observable list
nodes.summary: Tracks collection reads and structural mutations, not arbitrary item properties.

nodes.label: Dependency session
nodes.summary: Each body/configure build records dependencies and removes stale subscriptions.

nodes.label: WPF view host
nodes.summary: Owns one render session and reconciles descriptions with retained controls. Unchanged sibling order patches directly; keyed reconciliation moves a forward-displaced child once when its desired successor is adjacent, avoiding unnecessary detachments of intervening themed/native subtrees.

nodes.label: Batched dispatcher
nodes.summary: Coalesces invalidations into pending UI-thread renders.

nodes.label: Sibling identity
nodes.summary: Parent, key or position, kind, and component type determine reuse.

nodes.label: Mount and cleanup
nodes.summary: Subtree dependencies detach before unmount hooks; removed instances are released.

nodes.label: Native WPF controls
nodes.summary: TextBlock, Button, TextBox, StackPanel, and Border provide Windows UI.

nodes.label: Regression checks
nodes.summary: Executable assertions for state, components, identity, lifecycle, and scheduling.

nodes.label: Component demo
nodes.summary: Project board with shared editors, nested checklists, filters, preferences, telemetry, and recursive components.

nodes.label: Fine-grained updates
nodes.summary: Projected observation, local scheduling, and opt-in Memo reduce rebuilds; genuinely broad changes and native layout remain expensive.

nodes.label: Focus and IME
nodes.summary: Real-window tests cover regenerated editor keys, visual paths and TextBox selection; unkeyed/native segments require stable structure. IME and assistive-technology verification remain release gates.

nodes.label: Error recovery
nodes.summary: Body and validation failures retain the last tree. Patch failures clear the affected host, finish cleanup and permit explicit rebuild; arbitrary application mutations cannot roll back.

nodes.label: Styling and themes
nodes.summary: Basic dimensions, colors, corners, text size, spacing; advanced themes and style systems remain open.

nodes.label: Navigation
nodes.summary: Core owns observable typed history and entry identity; WPF owns active-screen lifetime and logical snapshots, including nested navigation and virtual rows.

nodes.label: List virtualization
nodes.summary: WPF viewport realization, keyed snapshots and incremental collection updates; focus, IME and accessibility verification remain.

nodes.label: Animation
nodes.summary: WPF screen entry fade/slide transitions with interruption cleanup and reduced-motion support. General animatable view properties remain planned.

nodes.label: Hot reload tooling
nodes.summary: Framework-specific refresh integration and state policies for code updates.

nodes.label: Other backends
nodes.summary: A rendering abstraction and non-Windows implementations.

nodes.label: Live data binding
nodes.summary: Live direct and record-projected binding with result equality filtering and accepted-value readback.

nodes.label: Stress workload
nodes.summary: 1000 mounted rows, 10000 projected writes, mixed edits, filters, remounts, and lifecycle balance measurements. The WPF package exposes one application-owned COM cleanup policy; the editor release workload and production consumer use it with explicit shutdown ownership.

nodes.label: Derived observation
nodes.summary: Computed values and State selectors notify only when their results change; subscriptions detach with the last reader.

nodes.label: Component input comparison
nodes.summary: Explicit immutable Memo inputs skip unchanged parent-driven child builds while preserving local updates.

nodes.label: Visible stress sequence
nodes.summary: A button runs 60 paced visible UI mutations with action highlighting, progress, and cancellation.

nodes.label: Experimental release preparation
nodes.summary: Published package version 0.1.0-alpha.3; experimental MIT-licensed source and NuGet preview with Windows validation, fresh NuGet.org package consumers, immutable workflow action pins and separate trusted publishing.
